decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p><span style="font-size:11pt">Prior to commencement of the development, a&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">noise impact assessment report by a suitably qualified person shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Environmental Protection Team&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">to provide an informed comment to the application.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The noise impact assessment report should have regard to the following:</span></p><p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">a. The [cumulative] measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the ASHP plant should be lower than the existing background noise level by 5dB at all times when the plant is in operation. </span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">b. Measurements should be made at a height of 1.2 – 1.5 metres above the adjacent ground level and at least 3.5 metres from any sound reflecting surfaces other than the ground or 1 metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance with the latest British Standard BS4142:2014. The measurement value should be adjusted to remove the additional sound energy contribution from reflected surfaces other than from the ground. </span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">c. The noise impact assessment should consider a worst-case scenario when the plant will be working at or near full load such as in cold weather conditions.&nbsp; </span></span></p><p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">d. The noise impact assessment should detail noise mitigation measures where these are relevant.</span></span></p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li><span style="font-size:11pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">Energy Centre - Plans &amp; Elevations -&nbsp;drawing no.0396&nbsp;- dated 19-03-2025</span></span></li><li><span style="font-size:11pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">Site Location Plan - Energy Centre - drawing no.0402 Revision 01 - dated 21-03-2025</span></span></li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
